# Forms API — operations

3 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `forms.get-forms` — **Get Forms** — `GET /forms/` (read, location)
- `forms.get-forms-submissions` — **Get Forms Submissions** — `GET /forms/submissions` (read, location)
- `forms.upload-to-custom-fields` — **Upload files to custom fields** — `POST /forms/upload-custom-files` (write, location, multipart)
  Post the necessary fields for the API to upload files.
